CanonicalVersionDetailResponse.description:
`GET /api/v1/canonical/versions/{id}` response body: the version
plus its published topics and relations (spec §5.2). Nests, rather
than requiring separate topic/relation calls, since a caller reading
one canonical graph version wants its whole shape in one round trip
and both are approval-gated identically (`ports.py`'s
`get_published_topics`/`get_published_relations`).
CanonicalVersionDetailResponse.title: CanonicalVersionDetailResponse

CanonicalVersionSummaryResponse.description:
One entry of `GET /api/v1/canonical/versions` (spec §5.2). Mirrors
`modules.canonical.domain.CanonicalGraphVersion`, minus the internal
`creator_owner_id` -- see `yuno.api.routes.canonical` for why callers
never see who ran the offline publisher.
CanonicalVersionSummaryResponse.title: CanonicalVersionSummaryResponse

Fetch one approved canonical graph version with its published topics
and relations. Raises `404` whether the version doesn't exist or just
isn't approved (module docstring).

Return the server-persisted onboarding session, if one exists.

The client deliberately keeps no diagnostic identifier in browser
storage. A cleared browser therefore resumes from the same durable
server state instead of silently starting another onboarding flow.
